product_overview: EduReach is an AI-powered college help desk chatbot that lets students ask questions and receive instant responses in a simple web interface. The app provides a home page with a chat interface for submitting queries and continuing the conversation.
core_goals: Ask college-related questions from the home page
Receive AI-generated answers to student queries
Continue an ongoing chat conversation with follow-up questions
Review chat history within the chat interface

features.name: College Chatbot
features.description: An AI chatbot that answers student questions about college-related topics through a web chat interface.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Enter a question -> Send the message -> See an AI response
Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Enter a follow-up question -> Send the message -> See the continued conversation in chat history
Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Enter a question -> Send the message -> See a loading indicator while waiting for the reply -> See the answer appear in the conversation
